title: Offer and muxed-account IDs accept unsafe integers, empty, hex and negative input and encode a different ID
severity_basis: Builder input: the SDK encodes a different ID than the caller gave, or a value stellar-core rejects. No reader impact. Fixed in 17.3.0 (pull request #1780); not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse an ID that is not a decimal integer in the unsigned 64-bit range (offer IDs: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: new MuxedAccount accepts an empty ID string and encodes ID 0. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse an ID that is not a decimal integer in the unsigned 64-bit range (offer IDs: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: new MuxedAccount accepts the ID string "0x10" and encodes ID 16. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse an ID that is not a decimal integer in the unsigned 64-bit range (offer IDs: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: Operation.manageSellOffer accepts the unsafe integer and encodes offer ID 9007199254740992. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse an ID that is not a decimal integer in the unsigned 64-bit range (offer IDs: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: Operation.manageSellOffer accepts an empty string and encodes offer ID 0 (a new offer). The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse an ID that is not a decimal integer in the unsigned 64-bit range (offer IDs: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: Operation.manageSellOffer accepts "0x10" and encodes offer ID 16. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse an ID that is not a decimal integer in the unsigned 64-bit range (offer IDs: signed 64-bit, non-negative)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: Operation.manageSellOffer accepts -1 and encodes it, which stellar-core rejects as malformed. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L4, on js@16.3.0 - 16.4.1 and js@17.2.0 - 17.2.1.
evidence.post_fix: js@17.3.0 and js@17.4.0 refuse the same inputs.
evidence.expected_basis: MuxedAccount.med25519.id is uint64 and ManageOfferOp.offerID is int64 in the XDR definitions (stellar-xdr v30.0); stellar-core rejects a negative offer ID as malformed.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 30 of 30 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0017.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added. The 16.x maintenance line receives critical security fixes only (js-stellar-sdk SECURITY.md); no backport request is drafted unless a maintainer decides to ask for one.
